notes.title: '20250109_1.1.3' Build Bugfix Notice
notes.content:
Hello, this is ENSCROLL development team In The Box.
We would like to provide an update regarding the critical bugs discovered in the 20250109_1.1.3 version and their resolution.

Identified Bugs

A bug where the owl does not disappear after submitting a special request (when the request involves multiple letters).
A bug where clicking on stationery causes the letter to zoom in infinitely.


As of 2025.01.09 9:00 (PST), both of these bugs have been resolved.
Please update ENSCROLL via Steam to enjoy the game without encountering these issues.


We sincerely apologize for any inconvenience caused during your gameplay experience.

notes.title: Youtube License Notice ( + 20250109 Hotfix )
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45320956/588a23d809872db0ee1d9074cafd4bfb1375d298.png

Hello, this is ENSCROLL development team, In The Box.

Today, we'd like to share information regarding youtube music copyright and hotfixes.

YouTube Upload Notice:

We are grateful to scroll crafters who enjoy our humble game and even upload videos to YouTube. 

However, we have belatedly discovered an issue where the Royalty Free music we used is automatically being demonetized through YouTube's Smart Content ID system.

How to Prevent Monetization Claims:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45320956/2bbeec0e58470532c1f61ede02cca2e8c92d2084.png

Simply including the keyword 'Enscroll' in your video description will automatically mark your video as an exception to claims.

For Already Uploaded Videos:

If you've already uploaded a video without the 'Enscroll' keyword and received a claim, please add 'Enscroll' to your video description and send us an email. We will verify and resolve it quickly.
netboy0524@gmail.com


Hotfixes

Westmark Receipt Response Issue

 Fixed a bug where the receipt message incorrectly indicated duration issues instead of effect issues when sending incorrect scrolls in Westmark's quest.

Save File Related Issues

 Fixed a bug where previous save data would persist when continuing the game after deleting save data without closing the game.
 The achievements [Top-Notch Service] and [No Hint Run] now trigger correctly without being affected by previous data.
 Character panels in the Quest Board now initialize properly. 

Resolution Adjustment Issues

 Fixed a bug where the resolution would appear blurry when switching from windowed to fullscreen mode through settings.


Special Thanks

We express our gratitude to Alexander Nakarada for providing great music and helping us resolve our issues quickly.

Used Music: "Kind Celtic Loop, Tavern Loop One, Celtic Atmosphere" by Alexander Nakarada 
www.creatorchords.com

notes.title: 20241231 Hotfix_v1.1.2
notes.content:
Fix save import errors

 Fixed an error where the game would not start if you had a save file created before the Japanese language was added, and you selected Japanese and chose Continue.

Requested wording corrections

 Removed a redundant paragraph from Irini's request in the Japanese version.
 Fixed awkward wording in Irini's and Xavier's requests in the Japanese version.


Happy New Year!

notes.title: 20241229 Hotfix_v1.1.1
notes.content:
Fixed answer error

 Fixed a bug where players in the Korean version would receive an incorrect reply if they failed “Otto Westmark's Last Request”.
 You will now be able to see what happened to Westmark properly.

 Fixed tutorial wording

 Fixed the wording of the Japanese version of the tutorial, changing the word “request sheet” to “letterhead”.

Fixed communication magic effect

 In the English version of the tutorial, the wording of the 3rd level enhancement magic effect of Communication has been changed from 'magic to communicate with spirits' to 'magic to communicate with elementals'.

Scroll Registration Ruling

 Fixed a bug where scrolls would not register on letter at once when dragging and dropping them onto a request after completion.
 Scrolls should now register better on letter.

Fixed request Text

 Fixed some confusing request content text.

notes.title: ENSCROLL v1.1 PATCH NOTE
notes.content:
To Our Dear Magic Scroll Crafters

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45320956/02515883bd4e50f805c28479a0b4ac307effb636.png

🎅Merry Christmas Eve!🎄

On this Christmas Eve, we would like to thank everyone who has been enjoying ENSCROLL since its release.

At the same time, we're here to inform you about the previously announced Japanese localization, additional content, and bug fixes.

Japanese Localization

Japanese Language Support

ENSCROLL can now be played in Japanese.
We look forward to meeting new scroll crafters!


Additional Content

📋 Quest Board

The Quest Board, which previously only showed the map without any functionality, has finally started serving its purpose!

The journeys of key characters are now recorded on the map.

You can now more intuitively check when their paths intersect.

Descriptions of major locations in the world have been added to the map.
Taking a closer look might prove helpful someday!

✉️ More Special Requests

Instead of repetitive regular requests in the late game, we've added some special requests.
New clients will visit you with more interesting stories!
We hope your scroll crafting experience will be enriched with new request-solving mechanics!


Bug Fixes

Circumscribed Circle Rune Bug Fixes

Fixed a bug where rune characters appeared overlapped in the scroll completion stage.
Fixed a bug where some non-enhanced magic circle runes had incorrect sizes.
You can now provide cleaner magic circles to your clients.

Reply Request Expansion Error Fixes

Fixed an error where rapidly clicking the reply envelope caused the reply letter to move to an incorrect position.
Fixed an error where the number of regular requests decreased when all special NPC requests were returned.

Korean Typo Fixes

Fixed Korean typos in requests and the magic grimoire.

Resolution Error Fixes

Fixed a bug where the ending credits were displayed with broken ratios for crafters not playing in FHD environment.
Fixed a bug where images like maps and magic circle backgrounds were being displayed at a lower resolution than intended.

Magic Circle Error Fixes

Fixed a bug where the circumscribed circle's color appeared dim when completing enchantment by clicking the magic name.
Fixed a bug where magic effect text appeared dim.

Keyboard Input Error Fixes

Fixed a bug where rapidly pressing spacebar and enter would result in multiple inputs when certain buttons were active.


Other Changes

Repayment Amount Balance

We realized that crafters were much more capable than we anticipated relative to our set loan repayment amounts.
The request fees for regular and special requests have been slightly adjusted.
Overall gold gains have been adjusted to prevent excessive gold accumulation.

Magic Spell Book Function

The Spell book can now be opened by clicking the upper tags as well.

Tutorial and Repayment Notice Improvements

We've added more detailed explanations for the scroll submission process, which many crafters found difficult.
We've revised unclear expressions to make the student loan repayment process smoother for crafters.


Known Issues

There is slight stuttering during request generation when changing fonts for Japanese request display.

notes.title: 241217 Hotfix
notes.content:
Fixed a bug where the name of the magic effect disappears when you rotate the magic symbol. You can now feel free to turn it around.

 Fixed a bug where the default language was set to Korean at the start of the game. Now it starts with your default system language.
